title: A temporal logic of epistemic and normative justifications, with an application to the Protagoras paradox
reasoning: The paper introduces a formal logic system (JTO) that combines temporal, epistemic, and deontic components. It is fundamentally concerned with the formalization of justifications for knowledge (epistemology) and normative obligations (morals and ethics). It applies this logic to provide a formal analysis of the Protagoras versus Euathlus paradox, specifically distinguishing between moral and juridical obligations.
